_README: Hand-written per-capability facts, merged OVER the extracted record by
vllm-capability-extract.py.  Keyed by the capability `key` (which is
`<id>@<lane>:<module>` when the id is ambiguous across lanes) or by bare `id`
when it is unique.  Nothing here is regenerated - the extraction is.
Use it for: one-line descriptions the docstring does not give, upstream
absorption evidence, retirement rationale, and - most valuable - a
verification handle for anything the AST cannot see.
Fields the verifier understands beyond the extracted ones:
markers  []  extra marker strings to look for (merged, not replaced)
note     ''  free text, shown in --json output
_BLIND_SPOTS: These five capabilities have NO verification signal of any kind - not a
marker, not an attribute, not a metric.  If the ledger's promise is 'an
upstream bump cannot silently drop work', these are precisely where it
would happen, and two of them are LIVE in production right now.
Fixing them means adding a marker string to the patch, which is a change to
a patch module and therefore out of scope for the session that built this.
P5b     lane-2 memory/p5b_page_size_pad_smaller  - env coordinator for P5
PN289   lane-2 observability/genesis_process_info - ON in both composes
PN201   lane-2 streaming/pn201_scheduler_empty_cache - ON in both composes

PN91G.note: fixes-lane vllm#48475 GDN spec-decode state-index clamp. Targets are built by a helper (_fla()) so the AST cannot see them; resolved by the whole-tree marker sweep. VERIFIED MISSING 2026-07-25 on the live tcbench container: third_party/flash_linear_attention/ops/fused_recurrent.py exists and contains ZERO '# PN91g:' - the patch is always-on in the entrypoint and had no effect. This is a live BUG-122-class instance, not a tooling artifact.

P39.note: P39a FLA chunk_scaled_dot_kkt persistent A pool. Was setattr-only and therefore INERT across `exec vllm serve` for months while logging 'applied' every boot. 69cae1bd gave it a self-install hook text-patched into chunk_scaled_dot_kkt.py, gated OFF by default behind GENESIS_ENABLE_P39A_SELFINSTALL. Zero markers with the flag unset is CORRECT. Live behaviour remains unverified until a boot with the flag on.

P89.note: completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens in chat usage. 'Upstream has this natively' is FALSE: reasoning_tokens exists only under entrypoints/openai/responses/; chat_completion has zero hits on all three image pins. The populated reasoning_tokens in bench rows was computed CLIENT-side (qbench45/bench/client.py). Three sub-anchors had drifted on EVERY pin, so P89 was silently inert for a long time rather than newly broken. Re-anchored 6edf8386 (content-sniffed, dual-pin safe).

PN119.note: AMBIGUOUS ID - two different patches. lane-2 PN119 = TurboQuant k8v4 GQA head-grouping kernel (vllm#40792). The house lens-router formerly called PN119 was renamed to H119 in bb501000 (fixes/patch_h119_lens_router.py) precisely to end this collision; the old flag name survives as a ':-' chain shim in the compose entrypoint. Renaming lane-2's PN119 is REJECTED: the vendored tree must stay byte-identical for git read-tree grafts, and P18B_TEXT anchors on PN119's post-apply output.

P18B_TEXT.note: TQ decode stage1 kernel-literal tune. COUPLED TO PN119: both anchors key on the launch shape PN119 EMITS, so if PN119 stops applying, P18B_TEXT necessarily misses too. Re-anchor the pair in ONE pass, never separately. Its own flag is commented out in the composes - it only announces APPLY via GENESIS_SNDR_TRUST_DEFAULT_ON=1.

PN346.note: RETIRED - do NOT re-anchor. PN346_ANCHOR_OLD count is 0 on all three image pins. The house /fixes pn87 applies, emits the byte-identical guard AND additionally fixes the fine-grained max_num_partial_units loop - a strict superset. Forcing PN346 would be HARMFUL, not neutral: lane-2 dispatches before /fixes and would consume pn87's coarse anchor. Documented in f5632b96.

P87.note: ABSORBED, closed on two independent grounds. (1) marlin_padded_nk (#45295) is native in nightly-0ba2aa35 and pads K as well as N; P87's drift markers now recognise it and self-skip cleanly. (2) Independently useless: #40361 was closed-unmerged, the text anchor is gone on BOTH engine pins, and P87 was never active on any validated boot - so even a revert of #45295 leaves it retired. docs/UPSTREAM.md:100.

PN79.note: RETIRED 2026-07-23 (BUG-119). The #46067 crash class is handled IN-TREE by turboquant_attn.py, which pre-reserves decode scratch and locks the workspace. The patch had silently SKIPped on every boot since the pin bump - weeks of conc-4 cudagraph+TQ+MTP bench load ran without it and produced zero device asserts, which is the evidence. Archived to fixes/_archive/.

PN73@fixes:patch_pn73_vendor_legacy_reas.note: Superseded by PN76 (engine-level deferred tool-call commit) and deliberately COMMENTED OUT in both compose entrypoints, kept for instant rollback if functional test D regresses. Not invoked == not a loss.

PN81.note: /rerank on :8020, adapting TEI + Cohere wire formats onto upstream /generative_scoring. Requires PN82. USER 2026-07-25: nothing consumes it; do NOT build out PN81 further and do NOT load a reranker model. Kill-switch GENESIS_PN81_RERANK=0.
